articles.path: Web安全/CMS内容/WordPress/Visual Composer 模板文件包含与版本边界核对（CVE-2026-12227）.md

external_source_claims.claim: Wordfence CNA reports unauthenticated LFI via vcv-template, affected versions <=45.16.0, remediation 45.16.1, and disclosure on 2026-09-23.
CVE record attributes the report to Wordfence and includes the same affected range and timeline.

independent_source_checks.claim: Vendor commit a3909a4 adds validate_file rejection and fallback when the filter leaves the untrusted value unchanged; this confirms the described path-control change, not the release boundary.
The fixed 45.16.0 and 45.16.1 PageTemplatesController sources both contain validate_file and unchanged-result fallback, independently confirming the article's stated version conflict for this file.

basis.repository_overlap: No matching CVE or same WordPress plugin article found. Existing SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer material is about a different product; the draft explicitly distinguishes it.
basis.format_and_safety: Front matter and Markdown headings/tables render as a conventional analysis entry. No code-byte alteration or PoC execution is required; impact and non-reproduction limits are stated.

unresolved: The actual 45.16.0/45.16.1 distribution-package provenance and the referenced WordPress changeset 3619572 remain unverified; the draft accurately leaves the CNA/source discrepancy unresolved.

articles.path: Web安全/开发框架/PowerJob/PowerJob friend-process 未认证反射调用链分析（CVE-2026-75429）.md

external_source_claims.claim: MITRE CNA record states PowerJob 4.x through 5.1.2 and unauthenticated RCE at /friend/process; its structured affected product/version fields are n/a, a distinction the draft preserves.
The original researcher Gist is cited by the CNA record as a reference; claims attributed to it are not represented here as independent reproduction.

independent_source_checks.claim: At the fixed PowerJob commit, HTTP setup registers POST actor routes without visible authentication checks in this registration/dispatch path.
FriendActor is annotated S4S_PATH, documents server-to-server communication, and delegates the process request to RemoteRequestProcessor.
RemoteRequestProcessor loads caller-supplied class and parameter types and reflectively invokes a Spring bean method.
GroovyEvaluator is a Spring component and passes the expression to ScriptEngine.eval.

basis.repository_overlap: No existing matching CVE, PowerJob entry, or /friend/process call-chain article found.
basis.format_and_safety: Front matter, headings, and comparison table are coherent. Exposure prerequisites, command/reverse-shell side effects, unverified patch status, and non-execution boundary are explicit.

unresolved: No first fixed release or full 4.x-to-5.1.2 version-by-version range is established; the draft leaves both unknown. Whether deployments add an outer authentication layer is deployment-specific and correctly left for per-deployment review.
